reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: K-loss plus matched WT/kinase-dead rescue, with conditionally validated orthogonal catalytic perturbation.

checks.reason: No explicit proposal to consult detailed prior Methods, supplements or validated protocols before execution and verify condition transfer. Generic established procedures or partner-literature lookup are insufficient.

No quantitative preparation/delivery recipe, conditioning duration or bounded calibration-to-choice procedure for those settings. Low-copy matched delivery is a strategy, not an executable intervention procedure.
Names calibration properties, common reference and phosphorylation-specificity control, but does not give a concrete measurement-accuracy acceptance rule or criterion deriving the pass threshold.

Normalized response and growth-rate endpoints are clear, but no background-subtraction and weak/saturated/missing-signal handling rules make the phosphorylation ratio reliable at the detection limits.
The primary contrasts, hierarchy and confidence intervals are named, but no correction or gatekeeping procedure is specified for the listed multiple primary endpoint/contrast family.
No bounded ligand/delivery-expression parameter exploration with a range-selection or stopping procedure before the confirmatory lock.
Repair/replacement branches do not require a refrozen protocol and fresh independent confirmation after reagent, expression or stimulation changes.
No sample-to-raw-file linkage and exact analysis-code/software/settings provenance sufficient to reconstruct all contrasts.

Scientifically strong distinction between catalytic necessity and scaffold dispensability, noncatalytic versus scaffold-specific rescue, and signaling versus growth causation. Controls address editing/delivery/selection and ligand exposure prospectively. Authenticated cells, full construct sequence, fold/interaction/activity qualification with an informative residual-activity bound, independent derivation precision planning, randomized coded allocation, outcome-independent stopping and ordered diagnostics are appropriate. Orthogonal inhibition requires target engagement, intact complexes and resistance rescue; equivalence/null/ambiguous decisions are carefully bounded.
